title: Add admin dashboard pages (manage activities, students, reports)
labels:

---

## Summary

Create admin-specific UI pages that allow teachers to manage activities, view student signups, and see reports.

## Requirements

- Add an admin dashboard page with navigation for Manage Activities, Manage Students, and Reports.
- Show the current activity list and allow editing / deleting entries.
- Show student registration status and optionally allow teacher-managed registrations.

## Notes

This issue is complementary to login/role selection and will give admin users a dedicated management interface.
